mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park with a temperature of 81 degrees.

The City of Verona has reached a major milestone with the Common Council unanimously adopting the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a guide for all future city growth. Additionally, the city continues to maintain its strong financial standing with a Moody's Aa1 rating.
There is plenty to do in our area, including the Dane County Farmers' Market and Puppets in the Park, both happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing on October 13.

Looking at the weekly police report, an incident occurred on October 3 where a 19-year-old was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following an investigation that began with a tip from the Cottage Grove Police Department.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake, and since the store is open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
